title: Capteurs & Énergie
description: Sensors and power of this computer: temperatures of the CPU, GPU, SSDs/disks, chipset and other probes with their warning/critical limits (Linux hwmon, NVIDIA nvidia-smi; Windows ACPI thermal zones, or every probe when LibreHardwareMonitor runs), fans and voltages; CPU frequency, frequency cap, turbo and thermal throttling (Linux intel thermal_throttle counters, Windows % Performance Limit); NVIDIA GPU throttle reasons; battery (charge, state, power draw, time left, capacity versus design = wear, cycles) and wireless device batteries; UPS (NUT upsc, apcupsd, or system battery); AC or battery; active power plan and available plans (Windows powercfg and power mode; Linux power-profiles-daemon or tuned); sleep modes, last sleep and wake, wake source, devices allowed to wake the computer, Windows Fast Startup. Findings flag hot components, throttling, a capped CPU, a worn or low battery, a UPS on battery, a power saver plan on AC and Fast Startup.

functions.name: get_sensors
functions.title: Toutes les sondes
functions.help: Toutes les sondes de la machine avec leurs limites : températures (chaque cœur du processeur compris), ventilateurs, tensions, consommation.
functions.description: Every sensor of this computer with its value, unit, minimum, warning and critical limits and source: temperatures (each CPU core included), fans (rpm or %), voltages, currents and power. Use it when the overview groups CPU cores or to check one probe.

parameters.name: type
parameters.label: Type
parameters.description: all, temperature, fan, voltage (and current) or power.

functions.name: get_battery
functions.title: Batterie en détail
functions.help: Détail de la batterie (et de l'onduleur) : capacité d'origine et actuelle (usure), cycles, charge, autonomie, avec l'historique de charge des derniers jours.
functions.description: Battery and UPS details: manufacturer, model, technology, state, charge, energy left, current and design capacity, health, cycles, power draw, time left; charge history over the last days (Linux: upower history; Windows: powercfg /batteryreport, which also gives the capacity history). Use it to judge battery wear or autonomy problems.

functions.name: get_wake_history
functions.title: Veilles et réveils
functions.help: Mises en veille et réveils des derniers jours avec la cause du réveil, minuteries et périphériques autorisés à réveiller l'ordinateur.
functions.description: Sleep and wake history over the last days (sleep time, wake time, duration, type, wake source), timers allowed to wake the computer and devices armed for wake. Windows: System log (Kernel-Power 42, Power-Troubleshooter 1), powercfg /waketimers (administrator for full detail), /lastwake, /devicequery wake_armed; Linux: kernel journal, systemd timers with WakeSystem, /proc/acpi/wakeup. Use it when the computer wakes up on its own or does not stay asleep.

functions.name: get_energy_report
functions.title: Rapport d'efficacité énergétique
functions.help: Windows : observe l'ordinateur pendant la durée choisie puis liste les problèmes d'économie d'énergie (périphérique qui empêche la veille, réglages…). Laisser la machine au repos pendant le test. Droits administrateur.
functions.description: Windows energy efficiency diagnosis (powercfg /energy): observes the computer for a while, then lists errors and warnings (devices preventing sleep, USB devices not suspending, power plan settings, battery problems). Needs administrator rights; the computer should be idle during the observation.

functions.name: set_power_plan
functions.title: Changer de plan d'alimentation
functions.help: Change de plan d'alimentation (économie d'énergie, équilibré, performances…). Le nom exact des plans disponibles est affiché dans la page. Annulable depuis l'Audit.
functions.description: Switches the active power plan. Windows: powercfg /setactive (plan name or GUID, as listed in the overview get_sensors); Linux: power-profiles-daemon (powerprofilesctl set power-saver|balanced|performance) or tuned (tuned-adm profile <name>). The preview lists the available plans; blocked for an unknown plan or when no tool is available. Undoable (previous plan).

parameters.name: plan
parameters.label: Plan
parameters.description: Plan or profile name (or Windows plan GUID), as shown in the overview's « Plans disponibles ».
